verdict.rationale: Supabase ships an official, documented MCP server enabling AI assistants to query and operate projects via natural language, corroborated by a live hands-on handshake against the production MCP endpoint and documented prompt-injection mitigations from a Supabase engineer. Missing for 10: independent quality benchmarking of the NL interface itself and full resolution of security concerns (e.g., service_role bypassing RLS in some client configs).
